correctness.rationale: The support condition is equivalent to the length-two relations because all arrow maps are scalars in a field. For fixed support S, the vertex torus has stabilizer \((\mathbb F_q^\times)^{c(S)}\), hence each orbit has size \((q-1)^{|Q_0|-c(S)}\) and the exact orbit count is \((q-1)^{|S|-|Q_0|+c(S)}\). Endomorphism equations identify \(\operatorname{End}_A(M)\) with the product of c(S) copies of \(\mathbb F_q\), so \(\operatorname{Aut}_A(M)\) has order \((q-1)^{c(S)}\). This proves the all-quiver formula; the finite checker is only corroboration.

value.rationale: Thin modules are a canonical dimension-vector stratum in quiver representation theory. The formula gives a complete all-quiver finite-field isomorphism-class count and refines it by endomorphism-algebra dimension, with exact automorphism-group orders for each stratum. This is useful for finite-field representation enumeration and automorphism-weighted module sums; it is not merely a single finite-table recomputation.
